info.title: PACE free-core API — review draft
info.description: Contract design only, 2026-10-11. No service exists. iOS+Android; age 18+ and trusted selfie verification before visibility/Like/chat. Proposed session and technical limits need review. Deferred billing/feed/activities/invitations omitted. Companion PACE_BACKEND_DESIGN.md defines transactions, eligibility and open decisions.
